aboutText: With 15 years of experience, Manx Custom Carpentry has been serving Seddon and surrounding suburbs like Footscray, Yarraville, and Newport. We specialise in kitchen renovations, bathroom transformations, and custom joinery, delivering quality craftsmanship to your doorstep. Our team is fully licensed and insured, ensuring every project meets the highest standards for Melbourne homes.
servicesText: From kitchen and bathroom renovations to outdoor decking and structural carpentry, we offer a comprehensive range of services. Each project is handled with precision and care, using quality materials to ensure lasting results for Seddon and Melbourne homeowners.
